method: Same d48 source ABBA original-A/production-B/production-B2/original-A2. Both one/native bank, same current allocation/raster/draw/upload/artist code; only stats/recordPeaks method providers differ. All raw samples pooled across four lifetimes per policy, not averaged quantiles. All 24 PNGs are decoded and compared at zero RGBA tolerance; original-A supplies six phase/lifetime image oracles.

baselineProvider.scope: Unprofiled same-current-source statistics/peak-accounting policy isolation. Original binds only frozen baseline stats and recordPeaks methods; production keeps current methods. Both sides use one native-mip bank. No latency-profiler timers or per-draw telemetry hooks. Imported baseline class is never instantiated.

methodProviders.setup: Current World3DLayer.create runs first, including existing bank/native-mip setup. Only original policy assigns the two frozen baseline method references to current cards/remainsCards instances before preparation/first draw.
methodProviders.scope: Same-current-source statistical peak-accounting policy ablation. Art, raster, transfer, allocation, order and all other methods remain current production. No per-draw timing observer or new render call.

limits: ABBA reduces simple order drift but only four lifetimes and 48 real samples per policy do not prove all hardware or stable tail distributions. Complete wall is GPU-completion/scheduling, not GPU nanoseconds/FPS.
Peak accounting is isolated with current cached page metadata on both sides. This is not every historical d48 change versus historical 5b allocation.
Full/World3D/Canvas timings are nested/residual and cannot be added. Cold real samples remain in headline values. No allocation profiler or GC attribution.
